For a 50-person Indian company, I’d shortlist these three live options and request a written quote against the same travel volume:

Offer	Total cost to budget	Terms to verify
FCM Travel India	Quote-based: management + booking/transaction fees + travel spend	24/7 support, cancellation/change fees, GST/ITC handling, hotel rate mark-ups, SLA, implementation fee. FCM offers negotiated hotel rates and corporate inventory. 
FCM Travel
+1

Amex Global Business Travel	Quote-based: management + transaction fees + travel/ground pass-through	Per-booking fee, supplier mark-ups, cancellation charges, duty-of-care, payment terms, reporting/API integration. Amex supports centralised travel billing. 
American Express
+1

MakeMyTrip MyBiz	Quote-based: booking/service fees + actual travel spend	Corporate discounts, convenience fees, GST invoices/ITC, cancellation/change handling, dedicated account support, credit terms.

Before paying: ask all three for a 12-month TCO showing every fee separately, including GST, mark-ups, refunds, amendments, after-hours support and implementation.

For 50 employees, also insist on a 90-day pilot/exit clause and no minimum-spend commitment unless the savings are contractually measurable.
